Overrated, less than authentic but decent
May 2018 • Friends
Had lunch here after a hot day at Ban Thanhb Market. Agree it looked inviting from the street. Filled with locals but don't expect too much from the food.

Pad Thai (OK, it's Thai but hey - it's at the top of the menu page) is a very local version of the famous thai dish. The seafood noodle did not fare that well too. It's street food, not the best but we came in here for the air con and retreat from the hot sun.

Price is decent, service is good.

Yummy Smoothie
Sep 2017 • Couples
We stumbled on this restaurant on our last day in Ho Chi Minh which was a bugger because if we had found it earlier we would have gone there more than two times in the same day.
Our first trip we were just looking for a cold drink so each chose a different flavor smoothie and all really enjoyed them so decided to go back for a late lunch. The food was great and the cocktails were the best we had in Vietnam. 
The staff are really friendly and spoke good English.

Best smoothies ever!
Sep 2017 • Friends
We stumbled across D'anver while walking back to our motel from the market. We were just wanting a cold drink.
The 4 of us opted for a different smoothie each and they were all fantastic. None of we're willing to share with the others. 
We were so impressed, we went back later for food.
The food was great but the cocktails were better.
Highly recommend this place for great drinks and food at a reasonable price.
The inside could do with a re-fresh but nothing major.

Marvelous service and great food.
Nov 2016 • Couples
You should pop in for the lunch set menu. Nice options, good price and the best thing, excellent service. In the set menu, from 11am until 1330pm, you get a nice little soup, a main and a drink. Peaceful and relaxing
Mar 2016 • Family
Sometimes it is necessary to get away and relax in the midst of the frenzy of activity that is Saigon. Tired of the markets and dodging motor bikes even on the sidewalk?Then try the quiet ambience of old colonial elegance in a garden setting just steps from Market and City Hall. The food is well prepared and efficiently served. We discovered this oasis by chance and went back several times for lunch and were never disappointed. Could have stayed for hours without pressure to leave. A must for the weary traveler.
